title: Meta Pauses Plan to Cap Free AI Glasses Feature at 3 Hours Per Month
summary: Meta began rolling out Conversational Focus with a software update in December, and you can enable it via a voice command or in the Meta AI mobile app. For any free feature, the usage limit will be refreshed each calendar month.
